name: Crash Test Tools
author: Nexus Labs
description: Adds a guarded FORCE CRASH TEST action in Crash Recovery to validate crash-report flow.

info.title: Crash Test Tools
info.what: Adds a safety-locked button that intentionally throws a runtime error for recovery tests.
info.how: When enabled, Crash Recovery shows FORCE CRASH TEST. Pressing it stores a crash report and triggers an intentional runtime error.
info.usage: Enable plugin in Plugin Manager and use FORCE CRASH TEST in Settings > System > Crash Recovery.
